comparison_selection: all official-test utterances where all five experts mark every canonical phone as score 2 and no expert marks an insertion; 179 utterances audited before model inference

human_phone_scores.1: right phone with a heavy accent; accepted for this protocol

phone_error_gold: At least 3 of 5 experts assign score 0 at the canonical position
word_error_gold: At least 3 of 5 experts mark a score-0 phone or an inserted phone in that word
strict_correct_position_control: All five experts assign score 2 at that position
accent_accepted_position_control: All five experts assign score 1 or 2 at that position
phone_normalization: Remove only trailing lexical-stress digit 0/1/2; retain AX, deviations marked *, and all categorical differences
prediction: Same CPU FP32 greedy CTC decoder and unit-cost canonical alignment as the demo; 2 threads; no confidence threshold tuning
unsupported_or_failed_records: Fail visibly and report coverage; do not silently drop records
insertion_reporting: Predicted insertions reported separately from canonical-position phone detection; word detection includes expert insertion votes
metrics_scope: External canonical-position/word detection under this rubric; not the L2-ARCTIC insertion-slot F1 and not a perceived-phone PER benchmark
